name: YY Cross MA
summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture directional moves by riding the trend after a crossover confirmation. The EA automates entry and exit based on the MA cross signals with configurable parameters for MA periods, methods, and applied prices.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了双均线交叉策略，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，当快速均线下穿慢速均线时产生卖出信号。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在通过交叉确认后跟随趋势来捕捉方向性行情。EA根据均线交叉信号自动化入场和出场，并提供可配置的均线周期、方法和应用价格参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生交叉，金叉做多、死叉做空。出场条件通常为反向交叉信号触发平仓并开反向仓位，或通过止损止盈参数控制。仓位管理依赖于手数参数的设置，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数来控制单笔交易的风险回报比。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。策略缺乏对市场状态（趋势或震荡）的过滤机制，也没有考虑交易成本和滑点对频繁交易的影响。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover strategy as its core trading logic, representing a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions are triggered when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA for buy signals, and when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA for sell signals. Exit conditions are typically based on reverse crossover signals that close existing positions and open new ones in the opposite direction, or through configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing depends on the lot size parameter configuration, potentially supporting either fixed lot sizes or equity-based dynamic sizing. Money management is addressed through stop-loss and take-profit parameters that control the risk-reward ratio for each trade. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and intuitive, but it is prone to generating frequent false signals during ranging or choppy market conditions, leading to consecutive losses. The strategy lacks a market regime filter to distinguish between trending and sideways markets, and does not account for the impact of trading costs and slippage on frequent signal turnover.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证，适合初学者学习趋势跟踪的基本原理
均线交叉是经过长期市场验证的经典策略，在强趋势行情中表现良好
参数可配置性强，允许用户调整均线周期、方法和应用价格来适应不同市场和时间框架
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify, suitable for beginners learning trend-following fundamentals
MA crossover is a time-tested classic strategy that performs well during strong trending markets
High configurability allows users to adjust MA periods, methods, and applied prices to adapt to different markets and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假信号导致频繁开平仓和连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤机制，无法区分趋势行情和震荡行情
默认止损止盈为0，存在未设止损导致单笔亏损无限扩大的风险
均线交叉信号具有滞后性，往往在趋势已经走了一段之后才触发入场
cons_en: Generates numerous false signals during ranging markets, leading to frequent open/close cycles and consecutive losses
Lacks a market regime filter to distinguish between trending and sideways market conditions
Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 poses risk of unlimited single-trade losses without protective stops
MA crossover signals are inherently lagging, often triggering entries only after a significant portion of the trend has already played out
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX指标或波动率过滤），在震荡行情中减少或暂停交易信号
加入新K线检查机制，确保每个K线只在开盘时交易一次，避免同一K线内重复信号
增加移动止损功能以锁定趋势利润，避免盈利回吐过多
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (such as ADX indicator or volatility filter) to reduce or suspend trading signals during ranging markets
Implement a new bar check mechanism to ensure trading only once per bar at opening, preventing duplicate signals within the same bar
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in trend profits and avoid excessive give-back of gains

risk_points: 默认止损为0，如果未手动设置止损则单笔交易风险不可控
均线交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续小额亏损累积
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一根K线内多次触发交易信号增加交易成本
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 means single-trade risk is uncontrolled if not manually configured
MA crossover strategy is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, accumulating consecutive small losses
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple trade signals within the same bar, increasing transaction costs
